project.title: Metagenomic and Metatrascriptomic Characterization of Background Aerosol Samples in the Continental US
project.description: This study establishes the first nationwide, seasonally resolved baseline of airborne microbial diversity in the United States. Air-filter samples collected at multiple urban and indoor sites were processed under a documented chain-of-custody, followed by co-extraction of DNA/RNA.
